title: Query count bounded by dimension
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\Omega$ and $\alpha$ be types, and let $T$ be a finite decision tree whose available coordinates are all of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. For any input $x:\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\Omega$, the number of queries made by $T$ on $x$ is at most $n$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite decision tree with all coordinates available
